content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-204. - Motor vehicle trespass.
content.summary:
It shall be unlawful to enter, ride, or remain in a motor vehicle of another without
               authorization from, or by threat to or deception of the registered owner or any authorized
               driver.
(Ord. No. 4006, § 2, 6-26-2006)
